Welcome to Capstone News Application’s documentation!¶

News App Models¶

Database models for the Capstone News Application.

Includes custom user accounts with role-based access, publishers, articles, and curated newsletters.

News App Views¶

Views for the news_app application.

Provides Django REST Framework API views for Articles, Subscriptions, and Approved Logs, as well as template-rendering Web UI views for viewing articles, managing user dashboards, subscriptions, publishers, newsletters, and account registration.

class news_app.views.ArticleListCreateAPIView(**kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: ListCreateAPIView

API endpoint to list all approved articles or create a new article.

get_queryset()[source]¶

Get the list of items for this view. This must be an iterable, and may be a queryset. Defaults to using self.queryset.

This method should always be used rather than accessing self.queryset directly, as self.queryset gets evaluated only once, and those results are cached for all subsequent requests.

You may want to override this if you need to provide different querysets depending on the incoming request.

(Eg. return a list of items that is specific to the user)

perform_create(serializer)[source]¶

news_app.views.article_delete_view(request, pk)[source]¶

Allow journalists or editors to delete articles.

news_app.views.article_detail_view(request, pk)[source]¶

Render detailed single-article view for approved news items.

news_app.views.article_edit_view(request, pk)[source]¶

Allow journalists or editors to edit existing articles.

news_app.views.dashboard_view(request)[source]¶

Render role-based dashboard for content submission and approval workflows.

  • Journalists view submitted articles and a creation form.

  • Editors view articles pending approval with options to approve or reject.

  • Readers receive general dashboard statistics and subscription links.

news_app.views.home_view(request)[source]¶

Render the homepage feed displaying all approved news articles.

news_app.views.newsletter_create_view(request)[source]¶

Allow Journalists and Editors to create new newsletters.

news_app.views.newsletter_delete_view(request, pk)[source]¶

Allow Journalists or Editors to delete a newsletter.

news_app.views.newsletter_detail_view(request, pk)[source]¶

Protected view: Full newsletter content and attached articles (Members Only).

news_app.views.newsletter_edit_view(request, pk)[source]¶

Allow Journalists or Editors to edit an existing newsletter.

news_app.views.newsletter_list_view(request)[source]¶

Public view: List all available newsletters with article previews.

news_app.views.publisher_create_view(request)[source]¶

Allow Editors to create new publishing organizations.

news_app.views.publisher_list_view(request)[source]¶

List all publishers and provide subscribe/unsubscribe actions.

news_app.views.register_view(request)[source]¶

Render and handle user registration.

Allows new users to create an account, select their initial role, and automatically log in upon successful creation.

news_app.views.toggle_journalist_subscription_view(request, pk)[source]¶

Toggle subscription status for a Journalist.
